correctness.rationale: Exact polynomial spectral projectors conjugate every commuting idempotent tuple to the corresponding diagonal labels over every commutative base ring. The incidence-unipotent group splits polynomially into a cross-color affine section and a diagonal-tuple stabilizer, proving the isomorphism as schemes. The Fortuin–Kasteleyn edge expansion, polynomial interpolation and elementary minimality argument establish the remaining implications. Exhaustive independent small-field incidence-algebra multiplication checks confirm fibers but are not used as universal proofs.

originality.rationale: The inspected primary results cover single-idempotent geometry, orthogonal-idempotent conjugacy and the classical Potts identity. They do not contain a statement or direct computation of the functorial all-arity affine scheme splitting, exact Tutte converse or sharp four-vertex nonreconstruction. This is best-knowledge originality, not a claim of exhaustive novelty.
residual_risks: General algebraic-monoid conjugacy theorems or specialized idempotent-scheme treatments outside the inspected primary sources could already imply part or all of the result.

value.rationale: A full functorial scheme classification in arbitrary characteristic resolves geometric components and point counts in every arity. Its Tutte-polynomial completeness gives a natural exact invariant, while the smallest nonisomorphic/ non-anti-isomorphic height-one posets with identical scheme families gives a structural reconstruction boundary, not a routine numerical specialization.
